Image Circle Crop

Crop any photo into a perfect circle with transparent corners — ideal for avatars.

🖼️ Drop an image here or click to browse

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image into the tool.
  2. The circular crop appears instantly.
  3. Click Download PNG to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What gets cropped?

The largest circle that fits inside your photo is kept; everything outside becomes transparent.

Why is the download a PNG?

Yes — only PNG keeps transparency. JPEG would fill the corners with a solid color.

What is it good for?

Avatars, profile pictures, logos and stickers.
